title: Inventory every SNS topic and decide each one's end
description:
**Reworked 2026-11-04:** Ryan reversed the architecture. No new AWS account and no central service; see docs/notifications-plan.md in AnthusAI/Caducus.

**Milestone:** M2, operators finished

**Goal.** The exact list to retire, so 'exactly two' can be checked, plus machine-only topics. Each deployment's account answers for itself now.

**Build.**
Live read of papyrus-production on 2026-11-04, 11 topics, us-east-1 (no alarms in us-west-2, eu-west-1, us-east-2):
- Human email: `papyrus-monitoring-alarms` (becomes the last-resort topic; one confirmed subscription and one stuck pending), two `papyrus-scheduled-job-knowledge-run-*` topics.
- Machine: `papyrus-newsletter-alarms-{distinctive,shipped}` (Lambda, the automatic pause: must not be removed without moving the trigger, PPY-f66e91's comment), `papyrus-newsletter-events-{distinctive,shipped}` (Lambda), and the same topic for dataparade, machines-on-machines and pilobol-us, with no subscribers.
- `papyrus-amplify-cost-alerts`: no subscribers. See `docs/amplify-cost-check.md`.
Source only, other apps: Chatticus `infra/lib/alarms.ts`, `auth-stack.ts`, `budgets-stack.ts`, `control-plane-stack.ts`, `thin-turn-stack.ts`. Babulus `packages/construct/src/index.ts`, `packages/control-plane/stacks/backend.py`. Add a live read at adoption. Open: AWS Budgets, whose EventBridge support was not checked.

**Acceptance.**
Table on kanbus-2b9a27; each row has an owner issue.
